articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Inside the chain settling $150 billion of stablecoins a week
articles.snippet: Tron launched as a content-distribution project and has become the settlement layer for a large share of the world's USDT, processing roughly $150 billion to $190 billion of stablecoin transfers a week. Josh Olszewicz of Canary Capital breaks down how the network's economics work and what stablecoin regulation could do to the thesis.

articles.title: Bitcoin's $16 billion quarterly options settlement arrives with a 'call-heavy' book
articles.snippet: Nearly $18 billion in bitcoin and ether options will expire on Friday, potentially reshaping dealer hedging flows and short-term volatility.

articles.title: MoonPay to acquire SEC-registered North Capital in $60 million all-stock deal
articles.snippet: The acquisition will support MoonPay’s aim of supporting mass adoption of tokenized real-world assets, CEO Ivan Soto-Wright said.

articles.title: BitMEX shuts down: perpetuals pioneer officially closes it doors after 11 years
articles.snippet: The exchange, co-founded by Arthur Hayes, stopped trading and deposits, but says users can still log in and withdraw funds as its wind-down continues.

articles.title: Zcash leads crypto majors with a 10% gain as bitcoin holds near $87,000
articles.snippet: Falling oil eased inflation worries through the Asian session, while a bill to make the government's bitcoin stockpile permanent moved further through Congress than any before it.
